summary_en: Toda Corporation completed post-adjustment for its accelerated share repurchase (ASR) transaction, finalizing the acquisition of 113,500 shares. The final average price was set at ¥1,542.67 per share based on VWAP from March 27 to September 15, 2026, plus dividend adjustment.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Post-Adjustment in Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR)
translation_en_brief:
On September 16, 2026, Toda Corporation announced the completion of post-adjustment for its accelerated share repurchase (ASR) transaction initiated on March 25, 2026. The final number of shares acquired was determined to be 113,500 shares.

The post-adjustment finalized the average purchase price at ¥1,542.67 per share. This price was calculated based on the arithmetic mean of VWAP (volume-weighted average price) for the period from March 27 to September 15, 2026, multiplied by 101.4%, plus a dividend adjustment of ¥12.90 per share. The initial transaction on March 26, 2026, conducted via ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading with Morgan Stanley MUFG Securities, had resulted in the acquisition of 4,651,100 shares at a base amount of ¥6,999,905,500. The post-adjustment mechanism reduced the final share count by 113,500 shares through an issuance to warrant holders via the exercise of stock acquisition rights.
